statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); ∀ p a : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → 2 < p → Nat.Coprime a p → ‖∑ b ∈ Finset.range p, (jacobiSym (b : ℤ) p : ℂ) * E ((b : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) / p))‖ = Real.sqrt (p : ℝ)

plain_statement.en: For every odd prime p and every natural a coprime to p, the complex Fourier sum of the Jacobi symbol at frequency a has norm exactly √p.
plain_statement.zh: 对每个奇素数 p 和每个与 p 互素的自然数 a，雅可比符号在频率 a 的复傅里叶和的范数恰为 √p。

brief.en: Identify the phase with the standard additive character on ℤ/pℤ. Twisting by the unit a preserves the Gauss norm, and the quadratic Gauss sum identity gives √p.
brief.zh: 将相位识别为模 p 剩余类环的标准加法特征。单位元 a 的扭转保持高斯和范数，再由二次高斯和恒等式得到 √p。
